messages:
Taylor: Quick broadcast: release freeze in effect starting 23:00 UTC for the weekly train. One exception requested for a tiny runtime GC tweak that reduces tail latency for embeddings. Need thumbs up from SRE + product to proceed.
Romi: What's the risk if we delay until next window? Any customer-visible regression?
Taylor: Measured impact: small Dedicated customers see intermittent 99p spikes (~120ms) under bursty load. Not service-breaking but noisy. Patch is low-risk and small.
Ava: Product ok with an exemption if SRE gives green. CS wants a short heads-up before full roll.
deploy-bot: deploy request pending: repo=runtime-gc, branch=fix/gc-minor, target=canary, initiated_by=@Taylor
SRE-bot: Request acknowledged. Propose baseline 15m -> deploy to canary -> 15m synthetic -> 10% -> 50% -> full, with rollback on 95p >5% regression.
Romi: :thumbsup: SRE approves the plan. I'll monitor traces.
Ava: I'll draft the Dedicated customer blurb; hold until we hit 10% green.
Taylor: Approved. Proceed when ready and post smoke results here.
deploy-bot: canary baseline started.
SRE-bot: Canary baseline complete. No anomalies.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-gc/canary -> image runtime-gc:fix-2026-03-25. build=6650
Taylor: Smoke: no crashes, GC pause metrics improved slightly, 95p latency stable.
SRE-bot: Canary health: PASS. anomaly_score=0.01.
Romi: Starting synthetic replay now.
Taylor: Synthetic run clean. Proceeding to 10%.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary -> 10%
Ava: Sending customer note to Dedicated contacts.
Taylor: Summary: freeze-exemption granted, GC tweak deployed to canary then 10%. Monitoring for next 2h. Will update release train notes tonight. :white_check_mark:
